name: Nevada

office.name: Nevada DOT Over-Dimensional Vehicle Permits (Carson City)

fees.note: NAC 484D.635(1)(a): single-trip permit $25, valid 5 consecutive days (NAC 484D.625). Applications needing special engineering research/inspection are billed at NDOT cost (NAC 484D.635(3)).

escorts.when: Over 12' wide, on two-lane and other roads

police.when: Over 17' wide, on two-lane and other roads
police.text: 1 police escort. Discretionary: loads wider than 17' on 2-3 lane roads - NDOT may require law-enforcement traffic control

police.when: Over 19' wide, on interstates and freeways
police.text: 1 police escort. Discretionary: loads wider than 19' on 4+ lane roads - NDOT may require law-enforcement traffic control
1 police escort. Discretionary: loads higher than 16' - NDOT may require utility escorts and law-enforcement traffic control

restrictions.text: No travel during hours of darkness (1/2 hr after sunset to 1/2 hr before sunrise), holiday hours, or weekends (Fri 1/2 hr after sunset to Mon 1/2 hr before sunrise) unless the permit or NDOT special instructions allow it.

Holiday hours (New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas): e.g. Monday holiday = noon-midnight preceding Friday and the Monday; Thanksgiving = noon-midnight Wednesday through Sunday. See NAC 484D.525.

I-15 between California line and Las Vegas (Exit 33): Friday 2-10 pm northbound and Sunday 2-10 pm southbound max width 12'. Over 12' wide: NDOT may add requirements for night, weekend and holiday travel; at night/holiday hours both front and rear pilot cars are required.
Single-trip application must be in by 4 pm the last business day before travel; special (over-max) permits 10 business days ahead.

travel.weekends: No travel on Saturday or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

sources.title: NRS Chapter 484D (size and weight limits; NRS 484D.600-484D.745)

notes: Fee and escort rules taken from the Nevada Administrative Code; the NDOT permit pages (dot.nv.gov) blocked automated fetch - verify current fee/ODVP instructions there.

Gross weight: NV uses axle limits (20,000 single / 34,000 tandem) + bridge formula with no fixed gross cap; 80,000 lb used as a typical threshold. Overweight permits are evaluated by axle configuration.
Pilot car for >12' wide is required in front on 2-3 lane highways and front+rear during hours of darkness/holiday hours on any road (NAC 484D.670(3)); the calculator models daytime travel.
Legal overhang: load may not extend more than 10' beyond front/rear (NAC 484D.650(1)(e)); combinations other than tractor + <=53' semitrailer are limited to 70' (75' including load).
Single-trip permit maximums without special approval: 14' wide, 15' high, 110' long (120' with steerable rear axle), 15' overhang - modeled as superload.
